name: railway-account
description: Manage Railway Account through the built-in Codex browser using the account selected for the current project, with optional read-only CLI/helper diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Use the active browser account for project-specific workspaces, projects, environments, services, deployments, variables, domains, scaling, incidents, and rollback. Management changes use visible UI controls; CLI/helper logs and status are optional read-only supplements with independently verified scope. Browser onboarding requires no API tokens.
defaultPrompt: Open Railway in the built-in Codex browser and select the account for this project.
Inspect my Railway Account resources without changes.
Plan a Railway Account operation and show its target and impact.
